description: Source code for the Sensor class implementation in Android HAL, managing sensor activation, batching, flushing, event reading, and thread handling.

classes.name: Sensor
classes.description: Implementation of a sensor interface handling sensor data collection, batching, activation, and threading.

methods.name: Sensor
methods.description: Constructor initializing sensor and starting the run thread.

methods.name: batch
methods.description: Sets the sensor sampling period within allowed min and max delays.

methods.name: flush
methods.description: Flushes sensor events if supported and enabled.

methods.name: startThread
methods.description: Static method to start the sensor's run loop.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Main loop for sensor data sampling and event posting.

methods.name: isWakeUpSensor
methods.description: Checks if the sensor is a wake-up sensor.

methods.name: setOperationMode
methods.description: Sets the sensor operation mode, only NORMAL supported.

methods.name: supportsDataInjection
methods.description: Checks if sensor supports data injection.

methods.name: injectEvent
methods.description: Injects a custom event into the sensor if supported.

methods.name: readEventPayload
methods.description: Reads raw data from hardware and fills payload.

methods.name: fillPayload
methods.description: Parses raw data string and fills event payload.
